roles_en: Commander of the Persian constitutional forces
bio_am: Կուկունեանի արշաւանքի մասնակից, Սախալին աքսորուած, Պարսկական սահմանադրական շարժման բանակի հրամանատար։ Ինկաւ 1912-ին։
bio_en: Yeprem, barely a youth, joined Sargis Kukunian's expedition of 1890 'when the cry rose from the homeland'; captured, he was chained and exiled as a criminal to Siberia and distant Sakhalin. Escaping, he made Atrpatakan (Persian Azerbaijan) his field of work, and in 1899 helped avenge the betrayal of the nine martyrs of Mahlam. In the Persian constitutional revolution from 1908 he became the leading commander of the revolutionary forces, with Armenian fighters such as Grish Khan, Keri and Nikol Harutiunian at his side. He was killed in battle in 1912 with the words 'I know I must die, but let me die with honour', and his widow Anahit was buried beside him in Tehran in 1931.
notes: Compiled from the archive review, 2026-10-12. Confidence: high. Surname (Davidian) and birth year not in the portions read; transliteration only.
